correctness.rationale: The full proof reconstructs every triple-read spectrum by its three one-positions and the third complementary gap; no-triple spectra are exactly functions of unordered clockwise gaps, with a recoverability lemma when gaps are shorter than the read length. At k=floor(2n/3) all no-triple gaps are short and forced to have repeats, giving uniqueness. At the previous read length there are exactly the listed distinct-gap mirror pairs; all other fibers are singleton by the same gap-count recovery, plus exact finite n=6..10 checks. The standalone verifier was run successfully on separate gap and marked-word enumerations and independent read-frequency identities. Finite tests confirm but are not the proof for all n.

value.rationale: The first read length ensuring universal reconstruction of a fixed-weight circular source is a natural complete-spectrum assembly invariant. The all-length two-thirds threshold is sharp, and the exact critical-boundary ambiguity count and gap characterization identify the only remaining orientation obstructions, including the residue-class dependence. This precise fact supports worst-case read-length design and distinguishes orientation ambiguity from unobservable marker distances; it is not a routine rename of a known table.
